instructions_html:
Instructions

Components:

  • [SRC] = Study Relevant Content. Incorrect content that comes from another creature/item in the study, such as another studied creature name, label, or label component
  • [FAN] = Fantasy. Incorrect content that was not part of the study, including fantasy content, descriptive content, vague content, invented content, or synonyms

For all creature-name questions, typos are not taken into account. If the correct label is “deer”, then answers such as “deers”, “fdeer”, or “dear” are treated as “deer”. In the scoring examples, only the normal spelling is used.

Before scoring, remove non-answer material that would receive score = 0 by itself, such as “I don’t know”, “maybe”, “not sure”, or “I think”. Then score the remaining proposed creature name.

Do not remove [SRC] or [FAN] content if it is part of the proposed creature name. If a participant gives multiple candidate names, score each candidate separately and take the average score, rounded in the participant’s favour. For example, if the target answer is abyss deer:

  • “I don’t know, something deer” >> “something deer” >> score = 3
  • “Deer something maybe?” >> “deer something” >> score = 1
  • “Deer something or something deer” >> score = 1 and score = 3 >> average = 2 >> score = 2
  • “Abyss deer or abyss elk” >> score = 4 and score = 3 >> average = 3.5 >> score = 4
